pieces.name: Shirt Collar Stand (yaka bandı)
pieces.cut: cut 2 on fold at centre back (1 self + 1 interfacing), the button-end band the blade rolls over

pieces.name: Shirt Collar Blade (yaka yaprağı)
pieces.cut: cut 2 + interfacing (1 upper, 1 under + interfacing), the turnover blade; sits on the stand and rolls over the seam

pieces.name: Smocked Yoke Panel (büzgü yaka panosu)
pieces.cut: cut 1 rectangle(s) 1081 x 160 mm (join to a 1051 mm flat top edge that gathers down to 350 mm), gathered smocked at the neckline
